channel.description: Latest articles from Magic Mile Media (magicmilemedia.com)

item.title: Supreme Court declines to block federal law banning TikTok in U.S.
item.description: The Supreme Court declined to block a federal law that would effectively ban TikTok in the United States if the video-sharing app does not divest from Chinese ownership.

item.title: Scott and Ash Mason to Share Insights at Social Media Summit 2025 in Kinston
item.description: The Social Media Summit 2025 (SMS2025) is gearing up to be an exciting event for professionals eager to explore the intersection of artificial intelligence and social media marketing. Among the notable speakers are Scott and Ash Mason, the dynamic duo behind The Hive Drive. Full-time travelers and digital marketing entrepreneurs, the Masons are set to bring their unique perspectives and inspiring journey to the stage.

item.title: Jason Michael Perry: Championing AI Transformation at the Social Media Summit 2025
item.description: Jason Michael Perry, a seasoned executive and Fractional Chief AI Officer, is one of the key speakers at the Social Media Summit 2025 (SMS2025). With over two decades of experience in AI and innovation, Perry is ready to share his insights on how businesses can effectively leverage artificial intelligence to thrive in the digital age.

item.title: Austin Carroll joins Kinston’s Social Media Summit to lead conversation on AI and compliance
item.description: On January 31, 2025, Kinston will host the Social Media Summit 2025 (SMS2025), a groundbreaking event focused on how artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping the world of social media marketing. Among the esteemed panelists is Austin Carroll, CEO and founder of Warrant, a startup at the forefront of marketing compliance for regulated industries, and an adjunct professor at Duke University.

item.title: Christine Kowalczyk to share expertise at Social Media Summit 2025 in Kinston
item.description: Christine Kowalczyk, an Associate Professor in the Department of Marketing and Supply Chain Management at East Carolina University (ECU), is set to join industry experts at the Social Media Summit 2025 (SMS2025) as a panelist. The event, scheduled for January 31, will focus on the intersection of artificial intelligence and social media marketing, under the theme "AI + Social: Innovate | Automate | Dominate."

item.title: Eric Lawrence to Speak at Social Media Summit 2025 on AI in Education
item.description: On January 31, the Social Media Summit 2025 (SMS2025) will gather marketing professionals, industry experts, and entrepreneurs at Lenoir Community College for a one-day event focusing on AI’s transformative role in social media marketing. Among the featured speakers is Eric Lawrence, Director of Growth & Partnerships at Imaginovation, LLC, a B2B software and app development company known for creating award-winning digital solutions.

item.title: Paige Lord to Speak on Responsible AI at Social Media Summit 2025
item.description: On January 31, the Social Media Summit 2025 (SMS2025) will bring industry leaders, innovators, and entrepreneurs to Kinston to explore the theme "AI + Social: Innovate | Automate | Dominate." Among the distinguished speakers is Paige Lord, Founder and CEO of Just AI, who will share her expertise on the responsible use of artificial intelligence in social media marketing.

item.title: Trey Scott promoted to VP of Sports Media & Digital Strategy
item.description: As Chief Correspondent for Neuse News Sports, Trey has grown the platform from 600 to over 10,000 followers, leading a regional high school sports show that regularly draws 20K-30K viewers per episode. He has also been instrumental in launching "Down the Line", a high school baseball podcast, and "NNS GameDay", a football show that has become a staple in local sports coverage.
